evidence.quote: I am confident the Federal Reserve can and will tighten policy well in advance of any threat to price stability, and successful execution of this exit will demonstrate that these emergency steps need not lead to higher inflation.
In fact, longer-term inflation expectations generally have been quite well anchored over the past few years of unusual Federal Reserve actions.
interest rates on bank loans relative to the usual benchmarks have continued to rise, the quantity of bank loans is still falling rapidly, and money supply growth has been subdued.
I do not believe central banks should raise their inflation targets.
will be a factor in our decisions about the timing and sequencing of steps to return the portfolio to a more normal level and composition.

parsed.rationale: A largely academic speech on policy frameworks that rejects higher inflation targets and affirms readiness to exit in a timely way, while noting weak lending and anchored expectations. Its net near-term policy signal is roughly neutral with a slight hawkish tilt.
